# min-of-5, cache-off (NIX_V3_NO_DISK_CACHE=1), user CPU seconds, byte-identical drvPaths.
# THE MEASUREMENT OF RECORD for CPU. The laptop is UNUSABLE for CPU levers: its
# ~5-10% noise floor exceeds the 3% keep-bar (proven 2026-06-19 — the attr-select
# IC measured −8% on the laptop at min-of-3 and REVERSED to +6% at min-of-5; on
# darwin-4 it is exactly 0.0%). All CPU grading MUST run here.
# CONVENTION (2026-06-20): every row is STAMPED with the commit it was measured
# at (last column) + the date.  Re-measure + re-stamp after any change that could
# move the eval hot path; a row whose `commit` is an ancestor of HEAD is STALE.
# The same numbers are also attached to the tested commit as a `git notes`
# (refs/notes/commits) entry — see `git notes show <commit>`.
# Key finding: the true v3-vs-TW gap is ~4.4-5.5× (LARGER + more uniform than the
# laptop's noisy 3.44×), byte-identical, and lives in the CORE EVAL LOOP
# (forceValue #1 leaf + callClosure + dispatchLoop) — systemic interpreter cost,
# not a hot-spot. See lode/V3_VS_TW_STRUCTURAL_ANALYSIS_2026-06-19.md.
# nixpkgs on darwin-4: hello-2.12.3, git-2.50.1, firefox-146.0.1; absolute times
# are darwin-4-specific — use for v3-vs-v3 A/Bs + the ratio, not cross-host compare.
